messages.subject: error in inla.posterior.sample
parts:
Hi all, 

I have this weird error when running the inla.posterior.sample (sam.post <- INLA::inla.posterior.sample(n = 1, result = mod)):

Error in file(rng.file, "rb") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In system(paste(shQuote(inla.call.no.remote()), "-s -m qsample",  :
  running command '"C:/Program Files/R/R-4.0.1/library/INLA/bin/windows/64bit/inla.exe" -s -m qsample -t 40 -r auto -z 0 -S default -v C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c6211151 C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c2a2c61d4 1 C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c51384be7 C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c5574416f C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c92835cc C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c31501ea C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c43423f8b C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c578b46b8 C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c48c7c0d' had status 253
2: In file(rng.file, "rb") :
  cannot open file 'C:/Users/gkonstan/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpgNv23T/file16c67547547/file16c51384be7': No such file or directory

I have write access, tried already:

> a=tempfile()
> a
[1] "C:\\Users\\gkonstan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\RtmpacwMij\\file1b0479b316e6"
> write("a", file=a)
> scan(file=a,what=character())
Read 1 item
[1] "a"

and also tried already a minimal example and it runs smoothly:

> r = inla(y~1,data=data.frame(y=0), control.compute
+            =list(config=TRUE))
> inla.posterior.sample(1,r)[[1]]$hyperpar
Precision for the Gaussian observations 
                               19997.2 

I also have the latest version of R (4.0.1) and latest testing version of INLA (just downloaded this morning).

Any ideas?

Best wishes, 
Gary
